Displacement has happened: Ethiopian Airlines says 2,500 farmers were displaced and re-housed in 2025 and that rehabilitation was largely complete by mid-2026 (Arab News/AFP; Capital Ethiopia, Aug 2026). But AfDB's only signed role is the 11 August 2025 mandate as lead arranger to raise debt; its US$500 million loan is 'earmarked... subject to Board approval' (AfDB via AFP/Oman Observer, Aug 2025) and was still awaiting board approval/appraisal in August 2026, with lender approvals expected by March 2027 (Capital Ethiopia; Travel Extra). change: dropped
why: No actual harm documented. The World Bank records a voluntary 'willing-buyer, willing-seller' purchase of ~3,000 ha of collective land it describes as arid, unoccupied and of little economic value, with no physical resettlement; the MAD 30.5 million price went to community projects (wells, irrigation, drinking water).
